fusions.name: Unhurried Release
fusions.desc: Looses at a target up to 9 tiles away, dealing 28 damage, up to 1.8 times that at the far end of its reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Skimming Shots
fusions.desc: Looses 2 low arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after each volley.

fusions.name: Steady Breath
fusions.desc: Steadies your breathing: your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far for 15 seconds, and you restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: While your stamina is full, your next ability deals 20% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
